title: Verify: Max-length tests assert counter text and blocked submit
summary: Rewrite contributionMaxLength tests to assert counter, alert and zero submit calls
description: Context: tests/contributionMaxLength.test.tsx renders the real sheet with the client mocked. Expected result: tests fail if the counter or overLimit guard is removed.
acceptance_criteria: 501 characters plus Send shows 'Too long: 501 / 500' and submitContribution called 0 times; exactly 500 characters is submitted
technical_constraints: Build long text with 'a'.repeat(MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH + 1) using the imported constant

steps.action: Ensure tests assert getByText('3 / 500') after typing 'abc', getByRole('alert').textContent toBe 'Too long: 501 / 500' after submit of 501 chars, expect(submitMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled(), and a 500-char case expects toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
steps.expected: All tests pass; removing 'if (overLimit) return;' makes the 501-char test fail
